sessions.title: Govern Once, Use Everywhere: Scale Copilot with Microsoft Plugin Registry
sessions.description: As Microsoft Copilot extensibility grows, governance can get complex. Learn how the Copilot plugin registry creates one source of truth for plugins, connectors, MCP servers, skills, and agents across Chat, Cowork, Scout, Code, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. See how unified publishing, approval, security, and governance help IT reduce overhead, improve discovery, and scale trusted AI innovation.

sessions.title: Agentify your business processes-the next era of business applications
sessions.description: Stop managing work. Start accelerating it. Join this session to see how AI agents can intelligently connect people, data, and applications to move business processes forward with less friction and fewer delays. Explore what the next era of business applications looks like and how it can help your organization make faster decisions, free up valuable resources, and achieve more with every team.

sessions.title: Agents in Copilot: help every user get more done
sessions.description: Getting value from agents takes more than deployment. Learn how to help users discover, trust, and use agents in Microsoft 365. See practical approaches for identifying the right use cases, guiding everyday workflows, and driving adoption so teams can get more value from Copilot and agents.

sessions.title: Frontier tuning: Optimize AI agents for real-world business outcomes
sessions.description: AI success depends on more than the model. Learn how Frontier Tuning helps organizations optimize models, tools, skills, knowledge, and evaluation frameworks to improve performance on real business workflows. See how Copilot Studio and Foundry work together to deliver better outcomes, higher quality, and improved cost efficiency at scale.

sessions.title: Agentic automation: How Copilot Studio blends workflows and agents
sessions.description: Deterministic and non-deterministic thinking are the core of why Copilot Studio enables mixing Workflows and Agents. See how we're taking this to the next level with new workflow authoring experiences, integration with agents, and enhanced reliability.

sessions.title: See how the Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Studio
sessions.description: Go behind the build of the new Microsoft Copilot harness in Copilot Studio. Learn how hooks, skills, multi-agent orchestration, models, context, and tools come together to power complex, long-running agents, and explore the Azure container architecture that underpins the runtime. See how this architecture helps organizations create agents that are more capable, reliable, reusable, and secure, while providing a durable foundation that evolves with AI models and business needs.

sessions.title: From tool to teammate: Persistent agents for shared processes in Copilot Studio
sessions.description: Learn how to build Copilot Studio agents that behave like teammates for recurring business processes. See how agent accounts, triggers, business process memory, and agent refinements help agents work as their own entity, act proactively, retain process context, and continuously improve to facilitate recurring business processes - while the makers stay in control. See how these agents benefit from additional capabilities like app UIs in agents and computer use too.

sessions.title: Scale agents, not risk: Governance and FinOps for the enterprise
sessions.description: As agents move from experimentation to enterprise-wide deployment, how do organizations scale adoption while managing risk and cost? Explore how different layers of Microsoft technology work together to provide governance, security, and cost management. With Copilot Studio agents as a practical focus, learn how to establish guardrails, understand usage and spend, and optimize as adoption grows.

sessions.title: Pick the right harness to build your agents with using Copilot Studio
sessions.description: When should you not build using the Microsoft Copilot harness in Copilot Studio? Come learn about how factors like the business process, its complexity, user experience, and cost influence which harness you would want to build your agent with. Leave the session knowing how to match the right harness to the job, while building agents that are fit for their intended purpose.

sessions.title: Apps and agents: Business process transformation in Copilot Studio
sessions.description: Discover how Copilot Studio brings apps and agents together on one governed platform for business transformation. Learn how apps provide structured experiences while agents reason and act across systems to transofrm end to end business processes. Come and see how makers and developers can build with natural language, connect enterprise data and actions, and move solutions from idea to production with shared security, governance, and lifecycle management.

sessions.title: What's new in Copilot Studio
sessions.description: A keynote-style talk on the biggest recent Copilot Studio features, including the newly upgraded all-in-one platform to build apps, workflows, and agents as well as exciting updates coming in the near future.

sessions.title: Your agent works. Now make it enterprise-ready.
sessions.description: Creating AI agents has never been easier. But what happens when they need to handle complex scenarios, connect to enterprise systems, take action, operate safely, and scale? Join us as we take you from experimentation to enterprise-grade agentic solutions through real examples, including autonomous resolution agents. Learn how Microsoft is moving from assisted to autonomous agents, and the architecture decisions, tradeoffs, guardrails, evals, and observability practices with trusted AI at scale.

sessions.title: Build personalized AI experiences with Work IQ
sessions.description: See how information workers and developers use Work IQ to power intelligent experiences across declarative agents, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and third-party platforms. Learn how Work IQ combines organizational context with connectors, agent-to-agent experiences, and external systems to create secure, personalized solutions grounded in your organization's knowledge, processes, and permissions.

sessions.title: Host apps from anywhere with the new Copilot Managed Runtime
sessions.description: Build AI apps on the platform of your choice and bring them into Microsoft for enterprise management. In this session, learn how the Managed Platform SDK enables integration with AI apps built across ecosystems, while Microsoft Admin Center provides centralized visibility, governance, security, and lifecycle management. Discover how to deliver AI innovation without sacrificing the controls and oversight your organization requires.

sessions.title: Build Customer-Facing Agents in Copilot Studio, Teams, and CCI
sessions.description: Your customers reach you on your website, in your apps, over messaging, and by phone. The new customer conversation harness in Microsoft Copilot Studio is built for every one of those conversations. Author once and publish across all of them, including Teams Phone, with the same knowledge and behavior across every channel. When a conversation calls for a human agent, it hands off to Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence with full context and your integrations intact. See how it works, and the various scenarios suited to your unique customer-facing business needs.

sessions.title: Deploy solutions at scale with Power Platform or Copilot Managed Runtime
sessions.description: Building is only the beginning. Learn how to deploy, govern, and operate solutions with Power Platform or Copilot Managed Runtime at enterprise scale. Whether you build apps, agents and workflows with Power Apps, Power Automate or Copilot Studio, Microsoft provides a platform to deploy and scale them with ease. Explore strategies for environments, application lifecycle management, security, monitoring, and administration that give IT control while enabling makers and developers to move quickly.

sessions.title: What's new in Power Platform
sessions.description: Microsoft Power Platform reimagines what's possible for makers and developers. Join this session for a guided tour of the latest innovations across Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages. See how AI is reshaping how solutions are built, deployed, and managed at scale and how low-code and agentic development unite in the most adopted AI-augmented low-code platform.

sessions.title: Run secure agent loops in production with isolated sandboxes at scale
sessions.description: Every enterprise is discovering how running agents in production is a platform problem, not a model problem. Agents need secure isolation, identity, governance, observability and cost control before anyone trusts them. This session defines how Azure Container Apps enables you to deliver an agentic platform with production-ready defaults, microVM isolation and governance. Learn how Copilot Studio and Foundry Agent Service leverage this architecture and how you can implement it in your enterprise.

sessions.title: Reimagining clinical workflows: A Brown University Health story
sessions.description: Brown University Health is moving from AI-assisted documentation to agentic workflows across clinical and operational settings. Learn how Dragon Copilot helps clinicians reduce documentation burden and stay focused on patients, while AI agents built with Copilot Studio surface hospital guidance, connect care teams with specialists, and streamline operations. Hear practical lessons for embedding trusted AI into existing workflows and scaling innovation across a health system.

sessions.title: Building and governing trusted AI agents in financial services
sessions.description: As organizations scale AI and agent deployments, trust becomes a critical business requirement. Learn how financial institutions are implementing governance, security, compliance, and risk management practices that help them deploy AI confidently. Explore architectural patterns, controls, and operational approaches that support responsible innovation while meeting regulatory and enterprise requirements.

sessions.title: Modernization to AI transformation: How Aon enables better decisions
sessions.description: What does it take to move from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide transformation at global scale? Learn how Aon is leveraging Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Platform to empower 60,000 employees, accelerate workforce transformation, simplify a fragmented automation landscape, and unlock millions in business value, all while building a future-ready foundation for autonomous agents and AI-driven growth.

sessions.title: Build, Monetize, and Grow: The CSP Partner Agent Opportunity
sessions.description: The agent opportunity is here, creating new ways for SMB partners to build, differentiate and grow. Learn how to move from first agent to AI at scale with prescriptive guidance to build, operationalize and govern agents across Copilot Studio, Foundry, GitHub and Agent 365. Explore how to turn agent capabilities into repeatable IP, managed services and Marketplace offers, with a practical path to build, monetize and scale your AI practice.

sessions.title: Partners: Unlock growth with AI across apps, agents, and workflows
sessions.description: Turn process reinvention into partner growth. See how Power Apps and Copilot Studio connect apps, agents, and workflows to move from AI strategy to governed deployment, agentic solutions, and continuous optimization. Explore innovations in orchestration, connectivity, governance and cost controls that help you scale. Leave with clarity on the partner opportunity, practical ways to differentiate, shorten delivery cycles, and deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

sessions.title: Developer's guide to Copilot Studio - Why and How
sessions.description: You know how to build an agent in code. So what does Copilot Studio add? In this session, we’ll show how developers can bring familiar pro-code practices like GitHub repo-backed development and agentic editing to Copilot Studio's connectors, monitoring and no-code experience. Build what your org needs locally in Visual Studio or even a terminal, then hand off to business owners to maintain and manage in Copilot Studio. Come see how Copilot Studio can complement the way you already build!

sessions.title: Beyond the Pilot: Turning Copilot & Agents into Business Value
sessions.description: AI pilots are everywhere. Sustainable business impact is harder. This session explores how organizations have moved beyond experimentation and are creating real enterprise value. Srini Raghavan moderates this panel discussion on prioritizing the right scenarios, aligning stakeholders, and measuring business impact.

sessions.title: Turn shadow agents into governed digital coworkers
sessions.description: Agents are everywhere, from Copilot Studio to custom Python apps, often without IT visibility. In this live demo, see how organizations transform unmanaged agents into governed digital coworkers using Entra Agent IDs, Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, access packages, and Purview policies. Then watch an external Python agent come under the same control plane using the Agent 365 SDK. Leave with practical strategies to govern, secure, and manage every agent in your tenant.

sessions.title: Scale AI without slowing innovation: From experiment to enterprise
sessions.description: How can organizations scale AI agents without slowing innovation? Explore Gilead Sciences’ experience with GENIE (Gilead Enterprise Navigation and Information Engine), built on a low-code Microsoft foundation. As interest grew, challenges included duplication, ownership, investment, risk and trust. Learn how centralized intake and early governance can improve decisions, while a reusable foundation and distributed ownership help move pilots toward enterprise capability with people accountable.

sessions.title: Observability at every layer for every role
sessions.description: As AI and agents scale, visibility, trust, and security become business imperatives. Join Charles Lamanna, Executive Vice President, Copilot, Agents, and Platform, and Hayete Gallot, Executive Vice President, Microsoft Security, to explore how observability at every layer of the stack helps organizations understand where AI is being used, how agents are operating, what risks are emerging, and whether investments are delivering results. See how organizations can turn visibility into action to scale AI with confidence. Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.

sessions.title: Copilot Managed Runtime: Build where you want, run with confidence.
sessions.description: Building an app is one thing. Making it ready for work is another. Explore how apps built with Microsoft and third-party tools like Lovable can become secure, governed business applications with Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime. This quick conversation connects the freedom to build with the confidence to put apps to work—and previews what you can explore further at Ignite.

sessions.title: How to be an Agent Boss
sessions.description: Every employee is becoming an agent boss: someone who builds, delegates to, and manages agents to amplify their impact. Jack Rowbotham shares the four patterns of human-agent collaboration, how to set your human-to-agent ratio by risk, and your role across the six-stage agentic lifecycle in Copilot Studio. Leave with the skills to thrive and one workflow to start with this month.

sessions.title: Behind the Curtain: Building Copilot Studio
sessions.description: Inside how the Copilot Studio engineering team builds the product with its own agents: which agents they run, what got faster, what broke, and what a small team can now ship.

sessions.title: Reimaging Clinical Workflows: Live with Brown University Health
sessions.description: Join us for a live conversation with Brown University Health as they share how they're expanding from AI-assisted documentation to agentic AI across clinical and operational workflows. Learn how Dragon Copilot helps clinicians spend less time documenting and more time with patients, and how AI agents built with Copilot Studio support care coordination, surface critical information, and streamline operations. Hear lessons learned and what's next on their AI journey.

sessions.title: Put Agents to Work: Charles Lamanna and Alysa Taylor on Copilot, Agent 365, and the Future of Work
sessions.description: Copilots help people get work done. Agents take action. Charles Lamanna joins Alysa Taylor to unpack the biggest announcements from Ignite and what customers should be most excited about. Charles explains what's changing as AI moves from assisting to acting, and why this moment matters for every organization. As agents start to access sensitive data and business systems, he names the one security step to take before you scale. He also shows how Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Agent 365 work together to help you build, deploy, and manage agents at scale. Watch for Charles's take on how work is changing and what excites him most about what comes next.

sessions.title: Build secure agents across the Microsoft stack
sessions.description: Anyone can build a demo agent. Shipping one that's secure and production-ready is the hard part. Learn how to build production-ready agents across the Microsoft stack, from Copilot Studio for business users to Microsoft Foundry for pro-code development, with security and governance considered from day one. See how governance zones, least-privilege access, agent identity, and lifecycle management can help turn a prototype into a production agent you can trust across industries.

sessions.title: Build an agentic platform to scale and govern digital workforces
sessions.description: Discover how IBM and Microsoft are jointly developing Imagine Enterprise to help enterprises build, run, and govern digital workforces. In this live demo, you’ll see how Imagine Enterprise combines IBM Consulting’s 6,000+ pre-built agents with Microsoft Azure, Copilot Studio, and Fabric to design, deploy, and govern a tailored digital workforce at scale. Learn how your organization can move from AI ambition to measurable business impact.

sessions.title: Semantic foundation for enterprise AI
sessions.description: Give AI agents a shared understanding of your business data. See how Semantic Fabric builds the foundation for trusted agentic AI by creating a governed ontology, semantic layer and knowledge graph on OneLake. Aligned with Fabric IQ and Power BI and governed through Microsoft Purview, it provides shared enterprise context to Fabric data agents, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, enabling grounded, repeatable and contextually relevant responses.

sessions.title: Deliver trusted, accessible AI where your teams work
sessions.description: Business users work in Microsoft 365, but vital enterprise data lives in Snowflake. In this session, learn how Snowflake Cortex Agents integrate with Microsoft Copilot Studio to bring governed answers directly into Teams and Copilot. Users can query structured and unstructured data in plain language without bypassing Snowflake’s security. We’ll cover the architecture, live setup, and best practices to deploy trusted, data-backed AI agents inside everyday workflows.

sessions.title: AI Governance Playbook: Scaling Agents Without Chaos
sessions.description: AI agents are quickly moving from experimentation to enterprise deployment, but most organizations lack a governance model to manage them at scale. Learn how leading enterprises are governing agent lifecycles, ownership, permissions, security, compliance, and business value using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI. Leave with a practical framework to accelerate innovation while maintaining control and accountability.

sessions.title: Scaling Copilot Studio Adoption Through Community-Led Agent Building
sessions.description: Building agents is only the first step. Sustainable adoption requires a community that helps people learn, experiment, share reusable practices, and move successful ideas forward. Explore how community-led agent building can create momentum for Copilot Studio, connect makers with experts, surface high-value scenarios, and help organizations scale agent adoption with greater confidence.

sessions.title: From Community to Production: Scaling Agentic Business Apps
sessions.description: Moving an agentic business application from an idea to production takes more than technology. It requires engaged users, practical feedback, shared standards, and a repeatable path from experimentation to business value. Learn how community programs can identify promising scenarios, connect builders and decision makers, and support the responsible scaling of agentic business applications.

sessions.title: Agentic ERP in action:Build agents & skills with Dynamics 365 ERP MCP
sessions.description: Go beyond copilots and build agents that can act on real business processes. Take a technical deep dive into Dynamics 365 ERP MCP, ERP apps for Cowork, and Copilot Studio. Learn how to connect agents to finance and operations data, workflows, and actions while maintaining enterprise security and governance. Leave with practical architecture patterns and development techniques you can apply immediately.

sessions.title: Build an enterprise app from a single prompt with Copilot Studio
sessions.description: One prompt. One coding agent. One working app, built live. See how app building in Copilot Studio turns natural language into an intelligent business application and dramatically changes how reliable business software gets created. Watch the experience unfold end to end, then see how easily an idea becomes an enterprise ready business solution.

sessions.title: How Vanguard is transforming advisor productivity with data and AI
sessions.description: Vanguard and Microsoft have built a sales advisor assist experience for Vanguard FAS using Microsoft 365 Sales Agent, Dynamics, and Microsoft Fabric. This session explores how the team is connecting relationship context, meeting preparation, outreach drafting, and coordinated follow-through into a human-reviewed workflow designed to reduce administrative effort and support more informed client conversations. Go behind the architecture to see how Dataverse Business Skills bring CRM capabilities into a conversational experience, alongside a Fabric-based approach to enterprise insights.

sessions.title: Copilot Studio unlocked: The new Microsoft Copilot harness for makers
sessions.description: See the new Microsoft Copilot harness in action and discover what it unlocks for Copilot Studio makers. In a live demo, learn how it expands what agents can do, enables richer experiences, and changes how makers build and extend agents.

sessions.title: From Reports to Reasoning: Reinventing PPM with AI and Power Apps
sessions.description: How do you rethink project portfolio management after 20 years of doing it the same way? Join Microsoft MVP Peter Kestenholz and learn how Context& used AI, Power Platform and Dataverse to replace traditional dashboards with AI-driven insights and build a fully interactive what-if scenario engine. Real-world lessons from serving 100+ global enterprises and accelerating innovation through AI-assisted development and user experience.

sessions.title: Essential Insights for Governing Copilot Agents
sessions.description: Organizations are rapidly deploying Copilot agents, but many lack the governance needed to scale securely. Learn a practical framework for managing agent lifecycle, security, compliance, and operational oversight using Microsoft Purview, Copilot Studio, DLP, and governance best practices. Leave with actionable guidance for preventing agent sprawl, protecting sensitive data, and enabling innovation while maintaining control.

sessions.title: Every agent is a principal now. Do you know what yours can reach?
sessions.description: Since July 2026 every new Copilot Studio agent gets an Entra Agent ID, and you can no longer opt out. That changes what an agent is: a principal with connector scopes, Conditional Access and a lifecycle. I build one live, then switch to the admin side and show what just landed in your tenant, including the part nobody enjoys. Agents created before the rollout cannot be migrated in place. You recreate them. Leave with a list of what to check in your own tenant on Monday.

sessions.title: Trusting Your AI Workforce: Securing and Governing Enterprise Agents
sessions.description: Discover how Microsoft helps organisations securely deploy and govern AI agents using familiar security, identity, and compliance controls. Through demonstrations and customer scenarios, you'll see how Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, and Copilot Studio work together to provide visibility, governance, and security for AI-powered agents. Join us to learn the essential practices every organisation should adopt before scaling AI agents across the enterprise.

sessions.title: Strengthen Copilot agent security with trusted data
sessions.description: Enterprises deploying Copilot and Copilot Studio agents move faster when built on trusted data foundations. See how Cyera and Microsoft work together to provide classification-aware context that strengthens Copilot Studio guardrails and helps security teams approve deployments faster. Discover every agent across your Microsoft estate, understand what data each can access, and reinforce runtime protection, including a live demonstration of agent quarantine grounded in trusted data classification.

sessions.title: Extend Copilot Studio agents to securely act on enterprise data
sessions.description: Work IQ and Copilot Studio give your agents context and a place to run across the Microsoft estate. Together, CData and Microsoft extend that reach to live systems of record beyond the Microsoft ecosystem. See how CData Connect AI Gateway carries your Power BI semantic model forward, giving Copilot Studio agents a scoped, governed path to read and act on enterprise data, auditable end to end.

sessions.title: Build with Lovable, ship in your Microsoft environment
sessions.description: Your team has ideas for internal apps and a security review standing between them and production. Experience an app built with Lovable live, then see two ways to run it in your Microsoft environment: Copilot Managed Runtime and Lovable on Azure. Explore what each path looks like, who controls what, and how to choose between them. Leave ready to build something that week.

sessions.title: Building agents with Claude in Foundry: Choosing your stack
sessions.description: Can you use Claude's agent harness on Microsoft Foundry? Yes. The real question is how much of the agent you want to own. This session maps out your options, from the Claude Managed Agents to Claude Agent SDK and Microsoft Agent Framework to Foundry Agent Service and Copilot Studio, along with one trade-off: control versus managed hosting. Leave with lessons from building Claude Code and Cowork, a way to keep tools portable with MCP and skills, and a simple way to choose between your harness and hosting options.
